C0996.title: Thai esports player sentenced for Arena of Valor cheating: 3 months jail
keywords: Thai esports player sentenced for Arena of Valor cheating: 3 months jail
C0996.summary: On December 15, 2025, Thai esports players Tokyogurl and Cheerio were accused of using remote-control methods to cheat through proxy play during the 33rd Southeast Asian Games Arena of Valor competition, known as RoV in Thailand. On March 17, 2026, Bangkok's Pathum Wan District Court sentenced the two to three months' detention; reporting also said the penalty was halved because they pleaded guilty. Because the case occurred in a national-team event, proxy play undermined confidence in match results and team reputation. It highlights governance risks around online match identity verification, remote-control detection, in-match monitoring, and evidence preservation.
